rules.title: Berkeley 2026 Annual General Adjustment (Rent Board Regulation 1148)
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may raise 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA is 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase, and it does not adjust rents for tenancies that began on or after Jan 1, 2025 and had rents set under Costa-Hawkins.
rules.quoted_span: adopted the Annual General Adjustment (AGA) Order for Year 2026 which will allow eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than January 1, 2026.
rules.effective_date_note: No earlier than January 1, 2026 per the notice.
rules.exemptions: Tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 with rents set under Costa-Hawkins are not adjusted by the 2026 AGA.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled units under the Berkeley Rent Stabilization Ordinance; landlords must meet the conditions in Regulation 1148 and give tenant notice.

unverifiable_exemptions: units exempt from the Rent Stabilization Ordinance

parsed.doc_summary: Berkeley Rent Stabilization Board public notice (Oct 17, 2025) announcing the 2026 Annual General Adjustment of 1.0% (65% of CPI), effective no earlier than Jan 1, 2026, under Regulation 1148 and BMC 13.76.110A.
